stories.title: Parlamentswahl in Israel: Israels Wahlkommission will arabische Parteien ausschließen

en.title: Parliamentary election in Israel: Israel's election commission wants to exclude Arab parties
en.summary: Israel's election commission is attempting to exclude parties representing the Arab minority ahead of parliamentary elections. The Supreme Court has previously overturned such exclusion attempts.

stories.title: Brasilien: Rekordhitze und El Niño verschärfen Feuerkrise in Manaus

en.title: Brazil: Record heat and El Niño intensify fire crisis in Manaus
en.summary: Multiple fires have engulfed the Amazon city of Manaus in thick smoke, with fire numbers rising more than 300 percent compared to the previous year. The climate phenomenon El Niño has contributed to the escalation.

stories.title: Waldbrände: Rekordhitze und El Niño verschärfen Feuerkrise in Manaus

en.title: Forest fires: Record heat and El Niño intensify fire crisis in Manaus
en.summary: Record heat and the El Niño climate phenomenon are contributing to a severe fire crisis affecting Manaus.

stories.title: Berliner Flughafen: Flugbetrieb am BER wegen möglicher Drohne kurzzeitig eingestellt

en.title: Berlin Airport: Flight operations at BER temporarily halted due to possible drone
en.summary: Flight operations at Berlin's BER airport were suspended for 45 minutes in the evening due to a suspected drone. The airport has since resumed normal operations.

stories.title: Wahlkommission in Israel stimmt für Ausschluss arabischer Parteien

en.title: Electoral commission in Israel votes for exclusion of Arab parties
en.summary: Israel's electoral commission has voted to exclude the largest Arab minority parties from an upcoming election scheduled in about a month. The Supreme Court will likely need to make a final decision on whether these parties can participate.

stories.title: Hendrik Holt in Dubai gefasst - Windkraft-Betrüger war geflohen

en.title: Wind power fraudster Hendrik Holt captured in Dubai
en.summary: Hendrik Holt, a convicted wind power fraudster, has been arrested in Dubai after fleeing for several weeks. He had failed to return to prison following an approved temporary release.

stories.title: BER stellte Flugbetrieb wegen Drohnensichtung kurzzeitig ein

en.title: BER suspended flight operations due to drone sighting
en.summary: Berlin's BER airport briefly halted flights after a drone was spotted near the facility in the evening. Flight operations resumed after approximately 45 minutes.

stories.title: USA laden Russlands Präsidenten Putin zu G20-Gipfel ein

en.title: USA invites Russia's President Putin to G20 summit
en.summary: The United States has invited Russian President Putin to a G20 summit in Miami, marking his first in-person attendance at such a meeting in seven years. Prospects for a ceasefire in Ukraine remain uncertain.

stories.title: Festnahme in Dubai: Die Flucht des Hochstaplers Hendrik Holt ist zu Ende

en.title: Arrest in Dubai: The Flight of Fraudster Hendrik Holt is Over
en.summary: Authorities in Dubai have arrested Hendrik Holt after weeks on the run. The former wind power industry figure, celebrated as a prodigy before being exposed as a fraudster, had abandoned his wife and child.

stories.title: Hendrik Holt: Windkraftbetrüger in Dubai festgenommen

en.title: Hendrik Holt: Wind Power Fraudster Arrested in Dubai
en.summary: Hendrik Holt, who sold non-existent wind parks to international power companies, has been captured in Dubai following his widely publicized escape. His case attracted significant attention across Germany.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: USA laden Putin zu G-20-Gipfel ein

en.title: USA Newslog: USA invites Putin to G-20 summit
en.summary: The U.S. State Department has invited Russian President Putin to attend the G-20 summit in Miami, with Washington hoping he will accept the invitation.

stories.title: Russland: USA laden Wladimir Putin zum G20-Gipfel nach Miami ein

en.title: Russia: USA Invites Vladimir Putin to G20 Summit in Miami
en.summary: The United States has extended an invitation to Russian leader Vladimir Putin to attend the G20 meeting scheduled for December in Miami. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed hope that Putin would accept.

stories.title: +++ Ukraine-Krieg +++: Rubio begründet Einladung von Putin zu G20-Gipfel in Florida

en.title: +++ Ukraine War +++: Rubio Explains Invitation of Putin to G20 Summit in Florida
en.summary: The United States has invited Putin to the G20 summit in Miami. Ukraine's president discussed reducing Russian revenues in New York, while Moscow reported intercepting over 500 Ukrainian drones.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: Anthropic-Chef warnt UN-Sicherheitsrat vor KI-Gefahren für die Menschheit

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: Anthropic Chief Warns UN Security Council of AI Dangers to Humanity
en.summary: The CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic advocated for international cooperation on artificial intelligence at the United Nations, following Trump's prior rejection of establishing a global AI control system.

stories.title: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq: US-Börsen schließen schwächer – Zehnjährige US‑Bonds auf über 5,1 Prozent

en.title: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq: US Stock Markets Close Weaker – Ten-Year US Bonds Above 5.1 Percent
en.summary: US stock markets declined as rising oil prices dampened sentiment, while yields on ten-year Treasury bonds reached their highest level since 2007 amid renewed interest rate concerns.

stories.title: Handelskonflikt: Verordnungen Nummer 834 und 835: Pekings neue Waffen im Handelskrieg

en.title: Trade Conflict: Regulations 834 and 835 – Beijing's New Weapons in Trade War
en.summary: China is expanding its trade defense tools beyond rare earth export restrictions, which previously brought Trump to negotiations, with potential impacts on German companies.

stories.title: Justiz: Geflohener Windkraftbetrüger Hendrik Holt in Dubai gefasst

en.title: Justice: Fugitive Wind Power Fraudster Hendrik Holt Arrested in Dubai
en.summary: A man wanted for fraud in connection with wind power investments and missing for four weeks was captured in the United Arab Emirates, according to prosecutors.
